name: movie-compass
description: Movie Compass — films placed on moral and taste axes, and the interface that reads a person onto them.

ATLAS_SERVE_FRONTEND.description: Serve the built interface from this dyno. Without it the dyno answers only the API and `/` is the pipeline page.

ATLAS_FRONTEND_URL.description: Where the pipeline page at /internal points people. The site's own address — https://moviecompass.net.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Only the sweep needs this, and the sweep runs on a laptop. The web dyno does not call any model.
